newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Bank Negara 91-day bills average yield 6.461 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank Negara 91-day bills average yield 6.461 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's central bank said it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.461 percent at its auction of 91-day Bank Negara bills for 500 million ringgit.
At its previous auction on April 1 for a similar amount, Bank Negara accepted bids at an average yield of 6.382 percent.
The bids accepted were in the high/low range of 6.485/410 percent against 6.399/364 percent last week.
The central bank said it also accepted bids for 30-day Bank Negara bills for 500 million ringgit, at an average yield of 6.489 percent against 6.399 last week.
The bids accepted were in the high/low range of 6.513/428 percent against 6.409/370.
Payment for both issues is on Wednesday.
The issues would be partly financed by the maturity of 500 million ringgit in Bank Negara bills.
